messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: v1.1 dependency issues (ecospat & rangeModelMetadata)
parts:
Hello everyone,
The newest version of ENMeval does not have ecospat and rangeModelMetadata packages as dependencies, which is generating problems when running a model on Wallace v1.1.
To fix this:
  1. Check that you have ENMeval 2.0 and Wallace v1.1 installed.
    Check it using:
    packageVersion("ENMeval")
    packageVersion("wallace")

  2. Install ecospat and rangeModelMetadata from CRAN.
    install.packages("ecospat")
    install.packages("rangeModelMetadata")
This should fix the problem. If you are still having issues, let us know. 

- The Wallace Team
